Error Code Legend

      

        
SESSION_NOT_FOUND — No checkout session exists for this order ID.

        
NOT_STARTED — WebAuthn vault not yet authenticated.

        
LIMIT_EXCEEDED — VPA hourly velocity limit reached (15/hr).

        
COOLDOWN_ACTIVE — Cancellation cooldown in effect. Wait before retry.

        
UTR_BOUND_TO_OTHER_ORDER — UTR already used on a different order. Cross-order reuse rejected.

        
ORDER_NOT_VAULT_VERIFIED — Hardware vault signature not verified before UPI launch.

        
SESSION_ALREADY_SETTLED — Order already completed successfully.
